CHBI TN — Central Higher Technical and Skill Development Board Institute
affiliations.detail: SPEDICS Skill Development Academy is an authorised training centre of CHBI TN (Training Partners of Skill India). Affiliated courses include Montessori Teacher Training, Child Psychology, Special Education, Dietician & Nutrition, Phonics, Vedic Math, School Administration & Management, and Spoken English & Hindi.

affiliations.name: iCEEDS — Innovation Council for Exquisite Education & Development of Skills
affiliations.detail: A Government of India registered certification body. ISO 9001:2015 certified for Quality Management System. NSDC (Skill India) certification partner associated with authorised training partners. Autonomous entity registered as a Trust under the Indian Trusts Act, 1882.

note: Affiliation and recognition apply according to the scope and validity stated in the respective official documents.
